1. The Conjugator

ÉL / ELLA / UD. habla Learn this form as the base.
TÚ = BASE + S hablas habla + S
ELLOS / ELLAS / UDS. = BASE + N hablan habla + N
The shortcut: If you know the él / ella / usted form, you can build tú by adding S and ellos / ellas / ustedes by adding N. This works with regular verbs, stem-changing verbs, verbs with irregular yo forms, and other irregular verbs. SER does not follow this pattern and must be learned separately.
Important: This conjugator teaches the relationship among these three present-indicative forms. Yo and nosotros/nosotras have their own patterns and are outside this conjugator.

2. Watch the Conjugator Work
